description: C.5 -- capture START per-transition metadata. Add the TriggeringCommand type + field to the SCRM model, thread it through ScrmSession::capture, and record it at the auto-capture hook from the SINGLE dispatch seam (no bespoke intercept). A command-caused transition records the command+target-kind; an interval/rule capture records None (explicitly absent, not an empty sentinel). Per-transition the logical ScreenModel (authoritative text; ANSI/Markdown render on demand) and the command metadata are recorded RELIABLY; the per-transition real-window picture is deferred (async-only in egui 0.33, documented tradeoff, Req 9.13/9.14). Also surface a selectable 'caused by: <command>' line in the ScrmViewer when present. Prerequisite for FEAT-002/FEAT-003.
steps: In crates/ff-scrm/src/model.rs add `pub struct TriggeringCommand { pub command: String, pub target_kind: String }` with derives Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Serialize/Deserialize, and add field `pub triggering_command: Option<TriggeringCommand>` to ScreenCapture, defaulted None in ScreenCapture::new. Re-export TriggeringCommand from crates/ff-scrm/src/lib.rs.

In crates/ff-desktop/src/scrm_session.rs extend ScrmSession::capture to accept an Option<TriggeringCommand> (or add capture_with_command) and attach it to the appended capture via collection.screens.last_mut(); update the two call sites (handle_capture SCREEN arm = None; auto_capture_active_context = the recorded command).

In the single dispatch seam (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dispatch.rs and/or shell/target_dispatch.rs) stash the last dispatched canonical command string + its resolved CommandTarget kind (mapped to a label String in the shell so ff-scrm keeps no ff-command dependency) into a new `last_dispatched: Option<(String,String)>` field on a grouped shell sub-struct in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state_groups.rs.
In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_scrm.rs::auto_capture_active_context read+clear last_dispatched and pass it to scrm.capture(...); a timed-interval / rule capture leaves it None (Req 9.12).
In crates/ff-desktop/src/scrm_viewer_panel.rs prepend a selectable 'caused by: <command>' line to the current capture view when triggering_command is present; omit it when absent (Req 10.9/10.10).
acceptance_criteria: A new ff-scrm unit test shows ScreenCapture round-trips triggering_command both absent and present through save_archive/load_archive (Req 17.2a).
A new ff-desktop test shows a command-caused auto-capture records the TriggeringCommand (command + target_kind) and an interval/rule capture records None (Req 9.10/9.12).
A new scrm_viewer test shows the 'caused by' line appears only when the current capture has a triggering command (Req 10.9/10.10).
No bespoke command intercept is added; the command is taken from the existing resolve_target/dispatch_command_target path (Req 9.11).
findings: Model: ff_scrm::TriggeringCommand { command: String, target_kind: String } (Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Serialize/Deserialize) re-exported from ff-scrm lib; ScreenCapture::triggering_command: Option<TriggeringCommand> is #[serde(default)] (absent round-trips cleanly; FEAT-002/003 may add more optional ScreenCapture fields the same way). Session: ScrmSession::capture(model, name) is UNCHANGED and now delegates to the new capture_with_command(model, name, Option<TriggeringCommand>); use capture_with_command when you have command metadata. Dispatch seam: the single front door shell/dispatch.rs::dispatch_command_string stashes self.scrm_ui.last_dispatched = Some((raw.trim(), target.variant_name())) ONLY on the resolve_target Ok path (the one seam) -- NO bespoke intercept. IMPORTANT for FEAT-002/003: the ladder fall-through path (run_command_ladder, for verbs resolve_target does NOT own) does NOT stash, so a transition caused by a ladder-only verb currently records None; if a later feature needs those captured, stash at the ladder seam too (do not add a second dispatcher). target_kind label values come from CommandTarget::variant_name(): menu | custom_workspace | function | macro | external. New grouped sub-struct state_groups::ScrmUiState { last_dispatched: Option<(String,String)> } on WorkbenchShell as field `scrm_ui` (init in shell/construct.rs); add further SCRM shell-side UI/bookkeeping fields here, not as flat WorkbenchShell fields. Consumption: commands_scrm.rs::auto_capture_active_context take()s last_dispatched (read-and-clear) and passes it to capture_with_command; it ALSO clears last_dispatched when auto-capture is OFF so a stale command never attaches to a later capture. This hook runs in nav_stack.rs::navigate_to BEFORE reconstruct_context (captures the DEPARTING context). Viewer: scrm_viewer_panel.rs current_screen_text() prepends a selectable 'caused by: <command>' line (format!("caused by: {}\n{}", tc.command, body)) only when triggering_command is present; the ScreenProvider reuses current_screen_text via current_screen_snapshot_text, so the caused-by line will also appear in a SCRM-viewer self-capture's text -- note this for FEAT-002/003 if that is undesirable. Per-transition real-window PICTURE is still deferred (async-only in egui 0.33, Req 9.13/9.14) -- only the logical ScreenModel + command metadata are recorded reliably. Tests added: ff-scrm model (new_capture_has_absent_triggering_command, capture_carries_triggering_command), ff-scrm persist (archive_round_trips_triggering_command_absent_and_present), ff-desktop scrm_session (capture_with_command_records_triggering_command, capture_without_command_leaves_triggering_absent), dispatch (target_kind_labels_are_stable), scrm_viewer_panel (caused_by_line_shown_when_triggering_command_present, caused_by_line_omitted_when_absent), shell/tests_scrm (auto_capture_records_triggering_command_from_dispatch_seam, manual_capture_screen_has_absent_triggering_command, staged_command_is_consumed_and_not_reused).
